featured_reviews.name: TripperHD Vlogs
featured_reviews.review_text:
Saifee Hospital Trust Blood Bank is a state-of-the-art facility located in Charni Road, Mumbai, India. It is licensed by the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) for the collection, testing, processing, and storage of blood and blood components. The blood bank is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and provides services to patients at Saifee Hospital and other hospitals in the Mumbai area.

Saifee Hospital Trust Blood Bank collects 100% voluntary blood donations. All blood donors are screened for eligibility and their blood is tested for a variety of diseases, including HIV, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, syphilis, and malaria. The blood bank also uses the latest technology to process and store blood safely and effectively.

Saifee Hospital Trust Blood Bank provides a wide range of blood and blood components, including:

Whole blood
Packed red cells
Saline-washed red cells
Fresh frozen plasma
Random platelet concentrate
Cryoprecipitate
Leucodepleted single donor platelet by plateletpheresis
Leukocytes by leukopheresis
Single donor plasma by plasmapheresis

The blood bank also provides a number of other services, such as:

Blood compatibility testing
Transfusion counseling
Blood component therapy
Blood product storage and transportation
Saifee Hospital Trust Blood Bank is committed to providing high-quality blood and blood components to patients in need. The blood bank has a team of experienced and qualified staff who are dedicated to ensuring the safety and efficacy of the blood products they supply.

Established by the Dawoodi Bohra community, the hospital is equipped with state-of-the-art facilities and a dedicated medical staff. Saifee Hospital is known for its comprehensive range of medical specialties, cutting-edge technology, and a patient-centric approach. The hospital has earned a reputation for excellence in various medical fields, including surgery, cardiology, oncology, and obstetrics. With a focus on delivering compassionate and advanced medical care, Saifee Hospital stands as a pillar of health in the bustling city of Mumbai, catering to the diverse healthcare needs of the community it serves.

featured_reviews.name: Siddhesh Aparaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
My father was admitted this month under CGHS benefits for diabetic foot surgery. As very few hospitals in Mumbai are empanelled under Central Government Health Schemes, we were relieved to get admission here.

The OPD procedures went smoothly. We were later informed that the patient would need to be admitted for a short duration (around two days) for surgical treatment. Since a private room was unavailable at the time, we opted for a multi-sharing ward.

Overall, the surgical treatment and interactions with the doctors and specialists were excellent. Dr. Rajeev Singh and his team took great care of the patient and kept us informed about the surgery schedule in advance, ensuring the admission was not done unnecessarily early.

However, the experience with the nursing staff was disappointing. Routine procedures were frequently delayed, and when assistance was requested, the behaviour was often rude towards both patients and visitors. In contrast, the ward-boy staff were more cooperative, welcoming, and helpful.

The discharge process was particularly frustrating. It began around 10:30 AM, but the paperwork was not handled in a timely manner and took over six hours to complete. There was no clear communication, and responsibility for delays was repeatedly shifted between departments. Since both of my parents and many other patients in the ward are diabetic, such prolonged delays are especially challenging. This is not an overreaction, but a genuine concern.

Additionally, the behaviour at the cashier counter was unprofessional. The staff member was rude, provided no estimate of waiting time, did not manage the queue properly, and even threatened to call security when questioned politely.

I understand that healthcare jobs demand immense patience and resilience, but this also comes with a responsibility to maintain professionalism and empathy, especially towards patients who are already vulnerable.

I am unsure whether these issues stem from hospital management or understaffing, but there is clearly room for improvement and accountability.

Despite these concerns, I remain grateful for the medical care and treatment provided by the doctors and the hospital overall.

featured_reviews.name: Sid The Explorer
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had visited here for voluntary blood donation. The experience was very good as the staff were courteous and professional.
During the donation I felt a bit uneasy, and the staff handled it promptly and calmly.
After the donation, they offered Frooti and provided a certificate, donor card, and a bottle as a memento, which felt thoughtful. Since I was not feeling fully normal, they also asked me to wait at reception for a few minutes and leave only after I felt completely fine.
The place is well maintained and is only a 5 to 7 minute walk from Goregaon West railway station. I would definitely recommend it for blood donation.

featured_reviews.name: Shivani Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
My colleague had an opportunity to volunteer for blood donation at Meenatai Thackeray Blood Bank, and it was an excellent experience. The facility was exceptionally clean and maintained high standards of hygiene, which made the process very reassuring. The doctors and staff were professional, approachable, and ensured everything was well-organized and comfortable for donors.
Highly recommended for anyone considering blood donation!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Went on 21st May 2021 for my father's 1st dose of Covishield vaccine.

Excellent arrangements and the place was properly maintained as per Covid norms. The staff was very friendly and helpful.

We took the afternoon slot, so it was less crowded. People with prior appointments were only taken in, so that might be also a reason for less crowd.

The place is #wheelchairaccessible on entrance and the lift. Recommended for Goregaonkars who would like a less crowded place for vaccination during this Corona phase.
